name: Rigged Draw
flavor: It had the winning hand. You saw it, and then it didn't.
castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within range hits with an attack roll or succeeds on a saving throw
description: Fate had already turned over, and you turn it back. When a creature you can see within range hits with an attack roll, or succeeds on a saving throw, you can make it reroll that d20 — it must use the new roll, even if it is better. Use it on a hit that was about to drop your ally, or on the save that was about to shrug off your side's best trick. You never choose the number; the deck just deals again.
narration: It had the winning hand. You saw it, and then it didn't — the card it was sure of is somehow a different card, and nobody at the table can say when the swap happened.
sheetSummary: Reaction: a creature within 30 ft that just hit with an attack or succeeded on a save rerolls that d20 and must use the new roll.
